summary: Apex Critical Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on October 5, 2026, solely to furnish a press release reporting assay results from holes RIFT26-020 through RIFT26-024 at its Rift Rare Earth Project in Nebraska. Highlights include 3.55% REO over 116.0 m (including 4.75% over 22.9 m) in hole 024 and 2.35% REO over 171.5 m in hole 022, extending the Trinity Zone about 200 m west. No securities transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated. This is routine exploration disclosure with no special-situation event and no risk-arb angle.
